reason: A DSH Web interface plugin for visually browsing and managing Skills across user and project scopes, including file-backed CRUD, renaming, and moving operations.

summaries.zh: 在 DSH Web 界面中可视化浏览、编辑、创建、删除、重命名和移动用户级或项目级 Skill。
summaries.en: A DSH Web interface for browsing, editing, creating, deleting, renaming, and moving user-level or project-level Skills.

capabilities: Lists and reads user-level and project-level DSH Skill files
Creates, edits, renames, deletes, and moves Skill files between supported scopes
Exposes a host-side JSON API for browser-based Skill management
Adds a Skills management panel to the DSH Web interface
